subject.title: Feature: Slack workspace file injection + global systemPrompt (parity with Telegram)

question: Should OpenClaw add a Slack account/global `systemPrompt` config field, or rely on existing per-channel and wildcard channel prompt configuration plus shared Project Context?
rationale: The workspace-file request is already handled generically, but the remaining request adds new Slack config surface and prompt precedence behavior, which AGENTS.md and VISION.md treat as compatibility-sensitive product direction.

options.title: Add Slack account/global prompt
options.body: Implement a typed and documented `channels.slack.systemPrompt` or per-account prompt inheritance path with tests for room, DM, MPIM, and slash-command prompt stacking.

options.title: Document wildcard-only workaround
options.body: Keep config surface unchanged and document `channels.slack.channels."*".systemPrompt` as the supported room-wide option, accepting that DMs and native slash behavior remain outside that model.

options.title: Defer to config include work
options.body: Wait for broader string-include/config ergonomics work before adding Slack-specific prompt surface.

recommendation.title: Add Slack account/global prompt
recommendation.body: Implement a typed and documented `channels.slack.systemPrompt` or per-account prompt inheritance path with tests for room, DM, MPIM, and slash-command prompt stacking.

likelyOwner.reason: The Slack scoped prompt feature history points most directly to `vincentkoc`; `steipete` is also relevant for config validation/refactor review.
